rootCause: Python json.dumps emits small exponents such as e-08 while ECMAScript JSON.stringify emits e-8. The parsed IEEE-754 values are identical, but textual canonical bytes differ, so Node correctly refused the Python report self-hash.

authorizedChanges.canonicalEncoding: Before sorted-key JSON hashing, finite non-integral floats become {"$f64be": <16 lowercase hex digits of the IEEE-754 binary64 big-endian bits>}; integral-valued floats become integers. Python uses struct.pack('>d'); Node uses DataView.setFloat64(..., false).
authorizedChanges.scope: Apply only to the canonical self-hash helpers in the three D4 Python tools and two D4 Node tools. Persisted scientific fields stay numeric and unchanged.
authorizedChanges.runnerAndAuditor: Bind C2, both retained failures, and use fresh root experiments/b62-camera-quality-holdout-render-v0-3.
